answer: Randomized deep-audit lottery. A newcomer locks a $90 audit bond; each finished job enters a draw where 1 in 20 faces a full forensic audit by three random established peers checking work, logs, and client result. Fail once and the $90 burns, profile locks 60 days. Pass 25 audited jobs in 45 days and the bond comes back with a badge. Faking 1,000 identities costs $90,000 in bonds plus 25,000 real jobs, about 6,250 hours of work, because audits strike blind. Like a wharf where customs cracks one walnut in twenty and a hollow shell seizes the shipment, only a real pearl gets through.
